toegepas.voor: Suid-Afrika is in nege provinsies verdeel wat elkeen sy eie regering het.
toegepas.na: Suid-Afrika is in nege provinsies verdeel, en elkeen het sy eie regering.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two main clauses read more easily for Grade 5 than a relative clause split off from its noun by the participle; the AWS comma joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: The relative clause 'wat elkeen sy eie regering het' is cut off from its noun by 'verdeel', which reads stiffly for Grade 5.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two main clauses joined by an AWS comma say exactly the same thing more plainly, with no fact added or lost.

toegepas.voor: Die regering sit in 'n stad wat ons die provinsie se hoofstad noem.
toegepas.na: Elke provinsie se regering sit in 'n stad wat ons sy hoofstad noem.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die regering' does not say which government (a learner may think of the national one); naming each province's government makes the reference clear without changing the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'Die regering' and 'die provinsie' have no clear referent, so a learner may read it as the national government.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming each province's government makes the reference exact without changing the claim, and it follows naturally on change 1.

toegepas.voor: want daar tel die natuur en die San se rotskuns albei
toegepas.na: want dit is op die lys vir sy natuur en ook vir die San se rotskuns
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daar tel ... albei' is vague and close to English 'both count'; repeating the paragraph's own 'op die lys vir' pattern says the same thing plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'daar tel die natuur en die San se rotskuns albei' is loose and close to English 'both count'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal repeats the paragraph's own 'op die lys vir' pattern and says the same thing (listed for nature and for San rock art) clearly; this is study text, not the glossary definition.

toegepas.voor: Noordwes, en die Pleistoseen-bewoningsterreine in die Wes-Kaap
toegepas.na: Noordwes. Die Pleistoseen-bewoningsterreine staan in die Wes-Kaap
toegepas.rede_vinder: The comma before 'en' sits between verbless parts of one long sentence, which the house AWS rule does not allow; splitting off the last part as its own sentence removes it, keeps the list clear and shortens the sentence.
toegepas.fout: A comma before 'en' between verbless parts of one sentence, against the house AWS rule, in an overlong sentence whose items already contain 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting off the last part as its own sentence removes the forbidden comma, keeps every place and the protected 'Pleistoseen-bewoningsterreine' intact, and reads more easily.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'stoppe' is an unusual plural and reads awkwardly; 'stopplekke' is the natural word for the stops on a route.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'stoppe' is a normal plural of the noun 'stop' and echoes 'stop by' in the sentence before; 'stopplekke' is a lateral move that could also drift from the route's wording in the other lessons.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: An adjective cannot be joined to a name with a hyphen; the compound noun 'kultuurlandskap' is the correct Afrikaans form, and the protected name ǂKhomani with its click stays unchanged.
na_skrywer.fout: 'ǂKhomani-kulturele landskap' hyphenates a name to an adjective, which is not a valid Afrikaans compound.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is the site's name and sits beside a protected-word ruling about it, so the writer must choose the form and use it consistently across the quarter.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: The established Afrikaans name is usually written 'Makapansvallei' (as in Makapansgat); it is a place name, appears twice, and was not changed here, so a person or the writer should confirm the intended spelling.

vlae.teks: 'n Wêrelderfenisterrein wat op die lys is vir mense se verlede daar. / Vier is op die lys vir hul natuur en sewe vir mense se verlede.
vlae.rede: The decided-definition note for 'gemengde wêrelderfenisterrein' says 'mense se verlede' is too narrow because the ǂKhomani site is listed for the ǂKhomani-San's living culture, yet this lesson defines a cultural site by 'mense se verlede' and puts the ǂKhomani site in that list; fixing it needs a content decision, not a language edit.
